show.title: Soulection Radio Show #157
show.content:
Joe Kay drops a 60 minute set of some stand out selects that he either just discovered, was holding onto, and rediscovered. 

<!--more-->
We played back a few cuts from last week such as the intro track by Yung Gud! God this track is a bad one even Sango is opening up with it at his recent shows.

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.
